purpose: confirmatory held-out comparison of the frozen coordinated policy with AIMD on a new PostgreSQL condition

protocol.primary: servedWithinSloPercent pooled over the four scenarios, coordinated minus adaptive; two-sided paired Student 95% interval; confirmed if the interval excludes zero
protocol.power: 64 pairs give about 80% power for +2.7 pp at sd 7.2 pp (estimated from the first held-out run)
protocol.conditions: service time, load scale, starting pool and limit and degradation factor differ from every training, validation and earlier held-out case
protocol.noChanges: model, decision rule, code and stand parameters are those of the first held-out run; this plan is run once
